name: System Return Criteria 2
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a system or a member of the system.

SystemIdentificationIndicator.name: System Identification Indicator
SystemIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the system identification is requested.

MemberIdentificationIndicator.name: Member Identification Indicator
MemberIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the member identification is requested.

CountryIdentificationIndicator.name: Country Identification Indicator
CountryIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the country identification is requested.

AccountIdentificationIndicator.name: Account Identification Indicator
AccountIdentificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account identification is requested.
